content_summary: The page discusses a class of splittings, the choice of a local uniformizer and local equation, and the behaviour of associated sections under specialization. A crowded added parenthesis contains a quotient of maximal-ideal-like m terms. The middle passage discusses conormal notation, regularity and invertibility. The later paragraph proposes studying specialization of sections of extensions of profinite groups, with an inserted qualification de deuxième type. It ends with the phrase moins brulant and car cela vient. This is a content description from the image; no mathematical statement was proved, computed or otherwise checked.
